This process helps in consolidating and integrating new information with existing knowledge, leading to deeper understanding and more robust learning. Reflection encourages the questioning of assumptions, the exploration of alternative perspectives, and the development of critical thinking skills. It fosters a growth mindset by allowing learners to acknowledge what they have learned and what they still need to improve upon.

Moreover, reflection can enhance motivation and engagement in learning by making the process more meaningful and relevant to the learner's personal goals and interests. It enables learners to set new learning objectives and strategies based on their reflections, thus creating a continuous cycle of learning and improvement.
